# YapThing

> Independent AI assistant for conversations, writing, research, study and project planning. Answers can be inaccurate; verify important claims.

## Official product information
- [Product facts](https://yapthing.com/product/): Features, platform availability and limits.
- [FAQ](https://yapthing.com/faq/): Direct answers to common questions.
- [Plans](https://yapthing.com/plans/): Current plan and credit terms; paid rollout is not verified.
- [Privacy](https://yapthing.com/privacy/): Data practices.
- [Deletion](https://yapthing.com/delete-account/): Account deletion guidance.
- [Support](https://yapthing.com/support/): Contact and access questions.

## Useful reading
- [Guides](https://yapthing.com/guides/): Practical workflows.
- [Research with sources](https://yapthing.com/guides/research-with-sources/): How to verify AI-supported research.
- [About and content standards](https://yapthing.com/about/): Product identity and correction guidance.

## Limitations
Android testing and iOS development are ongoing; do not infer public app-store availability. Live research depends on providers and quota. Computer Work requires authorization and a paired computer. This file is a discovery aid, not an access-control or indexing guarantee.
